name: kopai
description: Investigate production issues with your OpenTelemetry traces, logs and metrics in Kopai: root-cause analysis, dashboards, live pages, instrumentation help and, in Claude Tag, an on-call workflow that triages alerts, proposes alert rules, verifies fixes and writes handoffs. It never changes a system it monitors; it writes only what you ask for, such as a dashboard or instrumentation code, or an alert rule you approved.
